# 1 bed cottage for sale

> Derelict Cottage on 0.75 acre FOR SALE ; this cottage needs complete renovation throughout, and is located in a quiet rural location with outstanding sea view of Courtmacsherry Bay . Currently the cottage is situated on level site in surrounding fields . The cottage has been derelict for over 30 years . Building grants may be available on this property .
